en.content: If (2021)<sup>3762</sup> is divided by 17, then the remainder is __________.
en.explanation:
2021 = 17m - 2

(2021)3762 = (17m 2)3762 = multiple of 17 + 23762

= 17 + 22 (24)940

= 17 + 4 (17 1)940

= 17 + 4 (17 + 1)

= 17k + 4; (k I)

Remainder = 4
